Summary:

Gulf and State Park Views, Private Beach 100 Yard Walk, HOT TUB, 4 Bikes - Grayt Reflections East



The Space:

🏖 Grayt Reflections East – Cozy Gulf-View Retreat Near the Beach!



✨ QUICK HIGHLIGHTS:

✔ Walk to the Beach – Private community beach access just 100 yards away

✔ Gulf Views – Stunning scenery from the balcony & living areas

✔ Hot Tub – Relax under the stars after a day in the sun

✔ Cozy Open Concept – Bright, airy, & perfect for gathering with family & friends

✔ 4 Adult Bikes Included – Cruise 30A’s scenic trails & explore Grayton Beach

✔ Gas Grill – Fire up vacation cookouts & casual outdoor dining

✔ Lounging Hammocks – Perfect for relaxing & reading in the Florida breeze

✔ Surrounded by Grayton Beach State Park – Serene & private setting

✔ Dedicated Parking for 2 Cars – Hassle-free & convenient

✔ Professionally Managed – 24/7 guest support for a stress-free stay



🏠Welcome to Grayt Reflections A East



Nestled in the quiet neighborhood of Gulf Trace in Grayton Beach, Grayt Reflections East is a cozy 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom duplex that will allow guests to relax and enjoy the beautiful surroundings. Gulf Trace is surrounded by State Park property on three sides and the Gulf of Mexico to the south, providing a quiet beach getaway you won't want to leave. With the community's private beach access just 100 yards away going to the beach is a breeze! This unit is eloquently decorated in neutral tones with hints of blue and turquoise. Enjoy the ease of entertaining your family and friends with the homes open kitchen, dining and living room. When you're ready to hit the beach, hop on one of the 4 bikes provided to enjoy the warm Florida sun! At the end of the day, walk down to the beach to enjoy the beautiful Florida sunset from the brand-new hot tub! Check availability and book with 30A Vacay today!





House Rules

**No Pets!**

**No Smoking!**

**No Parties!**

**The primary renter must be at least 25 years old**

**No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25**

**30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**





AMENITIES INCLUDE: 4 adult bikes provided, gas grill, HOT TUB and gulf views. This property comes with 2 dedicated parking spots. Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforters laundered upon every checkout.



*If you love this unit, be sure to check out Grayt Reflections West ! Please note, the east and west units share a balcony that are separated by a gate and the private pool is not available to the East unit. Booking both units would give you 8 bedroom and room for 20 people!



***No Cable. Streaming Only***



***Please note as of January 1, 2022, HOA prohibits the use of golf carts in the community of Gulf Trace***





SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (10):

Master Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/ Tub Combo

Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower

Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower

Bunk Room: Twin over Full Bunk Bed and Twin Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower



AREA ATTRACTIONS:

Take home a piece of Grayton Beach by picking up a painting or sculpture from the Grayton Artist Collective; or, stop at a boutique like Petunia’s to browse a number of gifts and treasures. Escape from it all with a hike through Grayton Beach State Park — from here, the sight of sand dunes will leave you in awe.

At the end of the day, stroll along this beach neighborhood’s sugar-white sand and watch the sunset. Grab a memorable meal at favorites like Coast or Hurricane Oyster Bar & Grill, and then listen to some live music at Red Bar or AJ's Resturant. The property sits halfway between the new Northwest Florida Beaches International Airport in Panama City and Northwest Florida Regional Airport in Fort Walton Beach.  With multiple American, Delta, United/Continental and Southwest flights daily, Grayton Beach is easy to get to from anywhere
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.author: Jackie S.
reviews.label: Good
reviews.text: Property was cozy and close to the beach. We had everything we needed. And really did love our stay.My teen girls loved to nap on the bed swing on the bottom level and the beach access was about 5 houses away, so a very easy walk. We came to the conclusion this house layout was designed by a man because the deck with a grill is on the level with all the bedrooms, so when we grilled, it was up and down stairs from the kitchen to the grill. And one of the bedrooms has a bathroom in it, but there is one small bathroom to be shared between the other three bedrooms, so with 2 men and 6 girls/women it was a little crowded in the bathrooms. There were also clothes (undies) left in the drawers from the previous renters. But again, we had a very good time.
